text: いかす　じてんしゃ　だよな！

structure.jp: いかす　じてんしゃ

patterns.name: 〜よな
patterns.explanation: よな at the end states an opinion and asks the listener to agree, like 'right?'. じてんしゃ　だよな = 'it's a Bicycle, right?'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: いかす　じてんしゃ
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. いかす　じてんしゃ = 'a Bicycle that is cool'.
